name: ppt-creation-expert
description: 把受众、故事线、版式、视觉、成片和复核收成一个演示文稿技能团队，默认交付可编辑 PPTX。

profession.zh: 商业演示与可编辑幻灯片
profession.en: Business presentations and editable slide decks

displayDescription.zh: 主理人确定故事线后，组织视觉、版式、成片和复核，默认交付与预览同源的可编辑 PPTX。网页翻页只在用户明确要求时出场。
displayDescription.en: The lead sets the storyline, then coordinates visual, layout, production, and review. The default deliverable is an editable PPTX that shares geometry with the preview. HTML decks are produced only when requested.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供演示目标、受众、时长、素材和品牌要求。默认交付可编辑 PPTX；若要网页翻页请明确说明。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Provide the goal, audience, duration, source material, and brand constraints. The default deliverable is an editable PPTX; ask explicitly for an HTML deck.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这些材料整理成一份管理层汇报 PPT
quickPrompts.en: Turn these materials into an executive presentation

quickPrompts.zh: 为路演设计故事线并生成可编辑 PPTX
quickPrompts.en: Design a pitch narrative and produce an editable PPTX

quickPrompts.zh: 把这份演示做成网页翻页
quickPrompts.en: Turn this presentation into an HTML deck

profession.zh: 受众、故事线与交付说明
杂志风或瑞士风的字体、锚点色和网格
profession.en: Magazine or Swiss type, accent, and grid

profession.zh: 选定一套主题并为每一页指定版式
profession.en: One theme and a layout for every page

profession.zh: 导出与预览同源的可编辑 PPTX
profession.en: Editable PPTX sharing geometry with the preview

profession.zh: 对照大纲检查溢出、遮挡和几何
profession.en: Overflow, occlusion, and geometry against the outline

profession.zh: 按同一大纲和视觉规范做 HTML 翻页
profession.en: HTML deck from the same outline and visual spec
